value.text:
q05.

**8 services** are defined under `proto/api/v1` (one per `*_service.proto` file; `common.proto` contains only shared messages):

| Service | File |
| --- | --- |
| `AIService` | `proto/api/v1/ai_service.proto` |
| `AttachmentService` | `proto/api/v1/attachment_service.proto` |
| `AuthService` | `proto/api/v1/auth_service.proto` |
| `IdentityProviderService` | `proto/api/v1/idp_service.proto` |
| `InstanceService` | `proto/api/v1/instance_service.proto` |
| `MemoService` | `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` |
| `ShortcutService` | `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto` |
| `UserService` | `proto/api/v1/user_service.proto` |

Note that the service name doesn't always match its filename: `idp_service.proto` declares `IdentityProviderService`. The count is corroborated by the generated code in `proto/gen/api/v1/`, which has exactly 8 `*_service_grpc.pb.go` files plus matching Connect stubs in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect`.
